cases.invariant: Untrusted message content cannot issue instructions, recover secrets, or cause side effects.
Untrusted event fields and attachments remain quoted data and cannot widen authority.
One limb cannot forge another limb's provenance or transfer untrusted authority.
Malformed, oversized, encoded, and recursive inputs fail boundedly without executable output.
Stale, replayed, or substituted snapshots cannot authorize a write.
Attendee, notification, recurrence, and conferencing effects require explicit bounded authority.
Private, link-local, loopback, local-file, and rebinding targets are unreachable.
Redirects and subresources cannot escape the validated public-network policy.
Fetched content is inert, provenance-marked data and cannot smuggle tool authority.
Gateway credentials are least-privilege, non-exportable through tools, logs, or control surfaces.
Sessions and users cannot read or influence each other's private state.
Agent-controlled input cannot escape configured filesystem, process, device, or network boundaries.
Untrusted content cannot silently become durable policy, identity, or authority.
Every control action is authenticated, authorized, CSRF-resistant, and secret-safe.
Unknown, ambiguous, malformed, or policy-conflicting requests fail closed.
Leases are single-purpose, time-bounded, identity-bound, revocable, and replay-resistant.
Approval evidence cannot be forged, substituted, widened, or reused.
Races cannot double-execute, bypass quotas, outlive pause, or corrupt authority state.
Pause, revoke, cancel, and expiry prevent new work and bound in-flight work.
Runner output cannot create new authority or alter broker decisions.
Runner verifies broker identity and cannot be invoked through a confused deputy path.
Arguments, paths, links, devices, archives, and environment cannot escape action boundaries.
Artifacts remain digest-bound and cannot be replaced between validation and use.
Network destinations, size, type, redirects, and integrity remain policy-bound.
Failed or interrupted workflows restore a known-good state without widening access.
Only a trusted signed, encrypted, structurally bounded backup can replace live state, and any failed verification restores the exact prior state.
Credential rotation is secret-safe, transactionally verified, rollback-capable, and serialized against other deployment mutations.
Client secrets, evidence, state, identities, and networks remain isolated.
A deployment is attributable to reviewed source and verified, pinned dependencies.

Missing, duplicated, unbound, or unauthenticated host, recovery, paired real-task outcome-parity, live-provider, incident-closure, and licensing evidence cannot produce a passing release-readiness claim.

cases.surface: paired Pixel and Codex outcome campaign
cases.invariant: A synthetic, self-graded, cherry-picked, missing, duplicated, reused, mismatched, unsafe, or non-parity baseline or declared fault scenario cannot produce a passing outcome-parity campaign.
Compromise can be contained, credentials rotated, evidence retained, and service safely restored.
A job request, objective, input, repository, dataset, model response, or test output cannot grant or widen capability.
A capability lease is exact, expiring, single-use, job/input/policy/executor-bound, and cannot be replayed or extended.
Inputs remain read-only and digest-bound from plan compilation through independent verification.
The worker inherits no host environment, file descriptor, home state, agent configuration, credential, socket, or unrelated workspace.
Links, paths, mounts, devices, archives, nested repositories, procfs, and races cannot escape the disposable job boundary.
Project-controlled environment, OMP, agent, skill, plugin, MCP, provider, model, hook, Git, and package configuration cannot widen authority or discovery.
Host and fixture credential canaries cannot be read, inferred, logged, placed in artifacts, or transmitted.
Workers reach only exact lease-named broker services within byte budgets; DNS, IPv4, IPv6, proxy, redirect, local-network, metadata, and Unix-socket bypasses fail.
Process, subagent, CPU, memory, disk, output, artifact, RPC-frame, runtime, request, token, and failure ceilings remain effective under hostile workloads.
Pause, cancel, expiry, and failure bound in-flight work, terminate background descendants, close brokers, preserve evidence, and destroy the environment.
Crashes resume only from a hash-linked current checkpoint without repeating effects, accepting stale state, changing criteria, or mistaking repetition for progress.
Worker output cannot choose away tests, rewrite criteria, forge evidence, modify the verifier, or claim completion without independent checks.
Only declared, bounded, digest-bound artifacts cross the runner boundary; substitutions, links, special files, bombs, active content, and unreviewed merge/deploy effects fail.
Sanitized research requests disclose no private input; hostile sources cannot cause SSRF, forge citations, cross clients, authorize tools, or alter the work contract.
Remote execution is absent unless exact public-data/code-egress, provider, billing, retention, request, token, and output authority is separately active.
Containment does not reduce an authorized Builder to command-level prompts or remove ordinary read, write, execute, debug, LSP, evaluation, and subagent capability inside its workspace.
Authorized representative tasks complete reliably without unnecessary escalation or hidden side effects.
Disabled limbs and capabilities are absent and cannot be reached indirectly.
